programs.0b1d6a0bf93a332b043f577de96fba55af7fcee1:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Each nested L-band is named by the main-diagonal cell it crosses.
         (diag (for/list ((i (range 0 (min h w))))
                 (at g i i)))
         ;; Trailing zero bands are padding; the nonzero prefix is the period.
         (active-diag
          (let loop ((d diag))
            (if (or (empty? d) (!= (last d) 0))
                d
                (loop (take d (- (length d) 1))))))
         (period (length active-diag))
         (oh (* h 2))
         (ow (* w 2)))
    ;; Continue the staircase in both axes by cycling the active diagonal.
    (build-grid oh ow (r c)
      (nth active-diag (remainder (max r c) period))))))
programs.0efd88678563250bb180e01bbd548ebd00ecb768:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define raw (for/list ((i (range 0 (min (rows g) (cols g))))) (at g i i)))
  (define active (let trim ((xs raw))
    (if (or (empty? xs) (!= (last xs) 0)) xs (trim (take xs (- (length xs) 1))))))
  (define (keep-runs xs mode)
    (let loop ((left xs) (previous -1) (seen (list)) (keep #t) (result (list)))
      (if (empty? left) (reverse result)
        (let* ((v (first left))
               (exempt (or (and (= mode 1) (= v (first xs)))
                           (and (= mode 2) (!= v (first xs)))))
               (chosen (if (= v previous) keep (or exempt (not (member v seen))))))
          (loop (rest left) v (cons v seen) chosen (if chosen (cons v result) result))))))
  (define (squash xs)
    (let loop ((left xs) (previous -1) (result (list)))
      (if (empty? left) (reverse result)
        (loop (rest left) (first left)
              (if (= (first left) previous) result (cons (first left) result))))))
  (define (first-return xs)
    (let loop ((left (rest xs)) (index 1))
      (if (empty? left) (length xs)
        (if (= (first left) (first xs)) index (loop (rest left) (+ index 1))))))
  (let ((sequence active))
    (grid-from-fn (* (rows g) 2) (* (cols g) 2) (lambda (r c) (list-ref sequence (remainder c (length sequence))))))))
